title: Settlement Operations Manual — Deduction Schedules for the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement
content:
## 1. The deduction schedule

For each pay date of each payroll group, Paystride issues one deduction schedule under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, listing, for every worker of that group with an amount due on that pay date, the amount the employer must deduct. The schedule amount is the sum, over the group's workers, of the amount due on their Access plans for that pay date, and the worker count is the number of those workers. No schedule is issued for a pay date on which no worker of the group has anything due. A pay date and payroll group receive one deduction schedule.

## 2. Program status

A deduction schedule is issued only while the agreement status is live, suspended or terminating, as the agreement record shows. A suspended or terminating program keeps receiving schedules so that advances already made are recovered.

| Agreement status | Schedules issued |
|---|---|
| live | yes |
| suspended | yes |
| terminating | yes |
| contracted, implementing or terminated | no |

## 3. Delivery lead

A deduction schedule is delivered no later than the tier's deduction file lead, in business days, before the pay date it covers. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted backward from the pay date, so with a lead of two business days and a Friday pay date the file is delivered by the Wednesday before it. Delivery on the last permitted day itself is in time; the comparison is against the pay date recorded on the schedule.

Boundary cases on a lead of three business days, with no holiday in the week (hypothetical): for a Thursday pay date the latest delivery day is the Monday before it; delivery on that Monday is in time and delivery on the Tuesday is not.

## 4. Due date

The schedule's due date is the tier's remittance due period, in business days, after the pay date. On a tier with a due period of one business day, a schedule for a Monday pay date with no holiday that week is due on the Tuesday.
